issues.issue: The vote text says '14 Yes / 0 No against approval (14 No) in pediatrics' which is internally contradictory; the citation shows the pediatric Approval vote was 14 No / 0 Yes, so the drug was voted AGAINST approval in ages 12-17, not '14 Yes'.

Text states adult approval vote '11 Yes / 3 No' but conflates efficacy/safety/approval; the citation shows Efficacy 13/1, Safety 11/3, Approval 11/3 — the summary mislabels which vote is which and omits the efficacy vote.
Indication states 'aged 18 years and older' but pivotal trials enrolled 12-75 years; while the citation supports the label text, this is consistent — no fix needed (note only).

Population states upper age '75 years' but the cited design quote only says 'patients 12 years of age and older'; the 75 upper bound comes from a different (trial title/table) source and is not in this field's citation (uncited number 75).
Population upper age '75 years' is not supported by the field's cited quote which states only '12 years of age and older' (uncited number 75).
Approval date 'March 23, 2016' (uncited numbers 23/2016) is not contained in the citation quotes, which only reference 'effective on the date of this letter'; approval date is undated in the quotes.
Final report date 'December 2016' is not supported by the citation quote (uncited number 2016); milestone dates for all PMR/PMC entries lack citation support.
Final report date 'June 2019' not present in citation quote (uncited number 2019); same pattern across the PMC/PMR milestone dates.

Summary references a 'lung-function trial (3081)' but 3081 is not described as a pivotal trial anywhere and the number 3081 is uncited relative to that claim; mention is consistent with the design table but the lung-function characterization is not directly supported.
Randomization ratio '(1:1)' (uncited number 1) is supported by the n citation table quote ('Randomized (1:1)'), so the automated flag on 'design' is a false positive.
Priority review marked present=false consistent with summary stating standard PDUFA timeline; no contradiction, note only.
